integrity: The proof is self-contained from the standard Brandt multiplication and commuting criterion. Computational checks are presented only as finite consistency tests, not as proof for all \(n\).
limitations: Restricted to the aperiodic Brandt semigroup \(B_n\) and the ordinary adjacency spectrum.
The finite verifier checks \(3\le n\le8\); the conclusion for all \(n\ge3\) rests on the symbolic invariant-space proof.
A residual bibliographic risk remains for literature not indexed by the searched databases.
title: Spectral decomposition of Brandt commuting graphs
